$comment: Shipped with the starter kit. /setup copies this (and the rest of .claude/) to ~/.claude when the recipient chooses a global install, or leaves it here for a local install.

hooks.command: bash -c 'if [ -x "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/approve-readonly.py" ]; then exec "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/approve-readonly.py"; elif [ -x "$HOME/.claude/hooks/approve-readonly.py" ]; then exec "$HOME/.claude/hooks/approve-readonly.py"; fi'
